usedFor: Productboard holds features and notes, and Slack is where the team talks, so “New Feature Created” can run “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feature Created” in Productboard, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team hears about a new feature in a channel instead of checking Productboard.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for your approval, so “Send Message” posts only once you approve.
